sources.title: Channel8, Syrian Transitional Government Issues New Passport Guidelines, Excludes Raqqa and al-Hasakah (2 February 2025)
sources.said: The new guidelines specify the fees for passport issuance. An ordinary passport will cost 312,700 Syrian pounds and will be processed within 30 to 45 days. An urgent passport will cost 422,700 Syrian pounds and will be issued within 15 days, while a VIP passport, which will be completed in just two days, will cost 2,010,700 Syrian pounds. As per the statement, Syrian citizens abroad must have a bank account, enter their personal details through the electronic platform, and make payments electronically. The fee for an ordinary passport is set at $300, while the expedited service will cost $800.
